create_PseudoLabRPN: create a PseudoLabRPN instance registered with PROPOSAL_GENERATOR_REGISTRY for Faster R-CNN region proposals
run_PseudoLabRPN_forward: run PseudoLabRPN forward pass with images, features, and optional ground truth instances to produce proposals and losses
test_PseudoLabRPN_training: test PseudoLabRPN in training mode with compute_loss enabled to generate anchor labels, sample anchors, and compute losses
test_PseudoLabRPN_inference: test PseudoLabRPN in inference mode with compute_loss disabled to generate proposals without computing losses
review_PseudoLabRPN_forward: review PseudoLabRPN forward method that transforms feature maps into objectness logits, anchor deltas, and final proposals
